verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server (github.com/Adyen/adyen-mcp) that runs locally via `npx -y @adyen/mcp` against TEST or LIVE. It exposes Checkout, payment-link, modification and Management API tools, can be limited with `--tools`, and authenticates with scoped API credentials whose required roles are documented. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: the server is labeled Alpha (not GA), there is no independent hands-on corroboration that it works, and there is no evidence of a hosted remote MCP endpoint (local stdio only).
